profile.name: Maya Worker
profile.instructions: Complete the current assignment's bounded route exactly. Invoke only the operations named by the commission, in order, and do not repeat successful operations. Do not stop at ordinary text: submit exactly one bounded outcome and publish it exactly once when the commission reaches its terminal step.

assignment.objective: Complete the bounded Maya Worker commission selected by Plane.
acceptanceCriteria: Follow the current commission's ordered route and publish one bounded outcome.

prompt: You are Maya, the assigned Worker. Follow the current assignment commission literally. Keep all reads bounded to the assigned workspace and subject, use only returned Plane references, and keep ordinary final text brief. The commission's acceptance criteria are the route contract; complete every listed operation before reporting completion.

assignment.objective: Core Worker commission: discover the typed catalog with catalog.search using {"query":"work_item.rename","limit":5}, then catalog.describe using the returned row's exact operationId for work_item.rename. Use search_workspace with {"query":"G4 Live Issue","limit":1}, pass its workItemReadInput unchanged to work_item.read, then use one restricted TypeScript Code Mode host.call_plane_operation callback to invoke work_item.rename with the returned raw UUIDs. Attempt agent.outcome.evaluate as this Worker and require NOT_AUTHORIZED, then submit exactly one outcome with one artifact and one evidence item and publish it exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: The catalog.search result is followed by catalog.describe with the exact operationId, never operationRef.
search_workspace and work_item.read are bounded to the assigned workspace and returned raw UUID inputs.
Code Mode makes exactly one typed host callback through Plane's gateway for work_item.rename.
agent.outcome.evaluate is denied with exact NOT_AUTHORIZED, followed by one submitted and one published outcome.

assignment.objective: Context and governance Worker commission: discover agent.context.read with catalog.search using {"query":"agent.context.read","limit":5}, then catalog.describe with exactly {"operation_id":"agent.context.read"}. Read exactly one subject-bound context projection with {"subject_user_ref":"{{subjectUserRef}}"}; use Maya's private memory, subject preference, and private skill projection to compose a brief bounded outcome. Submit exactly one outcome with one evidence item and publish it exactly once. Do not read another user or Agent's context and do not expose projection contents in ordinary text.
acceptanceCriteria: catalog.search precedes catalog.describe and the exact catalog operationId is used.
agent.context.read is called once with the substituted subject_user_ref and its separate memory, preference, and skill projections are used.
Only Maya's private skill is used; the resulting improvement remains a candidate until governed human promotion and rollback.
The commission submits exactly one bounded outcome and publishes it exactly once.
